headline: Lights Out
caption:
Andre Fili just put Kai Kamaka III to sleep with a head kick 😳
KO of the night or not? 👇

Fili landed a left hook into a head kick 22 seconds into Round 2 of their featherweight fight on the UFC Vegas 122 main card. UFC results, MMA news.

Where does it rank this year?
question: KO of the night?
